I still have trouble believing that
Fan-sama is no longer with us...

rows.label: tlk46500171_03_msg0002

on the sculpture today, but I couldn't
even raise my arm to carve.

of drinking sweet Odifa.

Here, have some Odifa too.
It'll perk you up.
